ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central lobe regions) to low-intensity black pixels (perimeter and peduncle base).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones occupying approximately 80% of the visible ventral surface; distinct low-intensity black boundary along the trailing edge; sparse low-intensity mottling visible on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; approximate 45-degree interior angle; depth relative to lobe height is high.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary lobe surfaces transitioning to irregular, complex jagged curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, textured white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at distal lobe extremities; irregular, heavily jagged trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion on the lower-right lobe and central-lower fluke surface caused by high-intensity water spray and turbulence.
